reviews_verbatim.author: Cheryl Hutchinson
reviews_verbatim.text: We couldn't be happier with the incredible work on our home. From start to finish, this project exceeded every expectation we had.
reviews_verbatim.note: Quote trimmed at last complete sentence; Google truncated the rest behind 'More'.

reviews_verbatim.author: Melissa Hemmert
reviews_verbatim.text: Gustavo and his team were amazing to work with designing and building our custom closets! They were all professional, exceptional craftsmanship, installation and design. We love our new master walk-in closet.
reviews_verbatim.note: Original review literally says 'wall-in closet' (typo); corrected to 'walk-in' for site clarity, meaning unchanged.

reviews_verbatim.author: Angela P.
reviews_verbatim.text: If you live in the Naples area, this is the best closet guy you will ever find. He works within your budget and gets the job done very quickly. I love our new closets, absolutely spectacular!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Mary diaz
reviews_verbatim.text: Best business I could use they are very organized, detail, fast and responsable. love my closet I will definitely use them again.
reviews_verbatim.note: NOT used on site: review refers to business by its old name 'EG contractors', could confuse prospects. Kept here for record only.

reviews_verbatim.author: Eric Schankula
reviews_verbatim.text: It was such a pleasure to do this small home project with EG Contractors LLC. Gustavo was a great communicator and extremely talented.
reviews_verbatim.note: NOT used on site: same old-name issue as above.
